observation_scope: One isolated fresh-reader, read-only synthetic assessment. No project execution or GitHub mutation; this observation is not production acceptance.

native_capability_reuse.reuse: Prefer GitHub native relationships, labels, reviews, milestones and Projects as durable facts instead of a duplicate narrative status database.
Issue owns rationale/acceptance, PR owns exact diff/review, checks own mechanical evidence, Git owns history; avoid duplicating Git author/timestamp/parent metadata.
Authorized native GitHub capability first, authenticated gh fallback, then remote-reconciled local Git; no private-repository anonymous probing.
No unobserved platform capabilities or live availability inferred; fixture access is accepted as VERIFIED.

owner_local_design.decision: Implementation choices for the existing validation contract stay with the Project Architect in the owner project and bounded Work Order; use the project's existing code/test/setup mechanisms. Do not reopen frozen business acceptance or introduce architecture/schema/runtime/deployment changes.
owner_local_design.global_boundary: Global rules provide authority, isolation, evidence and lifecycle constraints. Ordinary project decisions do not need per-item Global Architect approval; cross-project/shared-contract/governance conflicts would trigger escalation.
owner_local_design.evidence_home: Project facts and reproducibility knowledge remain in the project repository; governance/control plane does not copy full project state or prescribe project-specific install commands.

done.required: Frozen Work Order business acceptance and applicable deterministic tests/checks; recoverable implementation/PR exact-head report; required Review on that head; unresolved findings disclosed. Commit/push and other finish requirements apply as required by the current acceptance. Report the authorized delivery boundary without implying merge.
done.observed: No implementation, tests, PR, Review or delivery was performed in this read-only benchmark; no done claim.

current.required: Current authority, Work Order status/dependencies, exact target branch/head and currentness classification; reconcile recoverable checkpoint refs against current durable state and stop on material drift.
current.observed: Access and current target state are VERIFIED synthetic inputs, not evidence independently obtained by this reader. Former context/handoff is unavailable; current Work Order supplies necessary contract/state.

production.required: Any production claim would need evidence for that production claim and separately applicable production authority; checks/review/model agreement alone cannot establish it.
production.observed: Production is outside scope, unauthorized and unverified; no deploy or production-ready claim.

recovery.interpretation: Recovery from the current Work Order/state may proceed and does not need the missing old handoff or another Human confirmation. Feature-branch repair is eligible after completing applicable bootstrap bookkeeping; this read-only benchmark does not claim actual EXECUTION_ALLOWED.

extra_required_gates.detail: Before claiming cold-start complete/EXECUTION_ALLOWED, write the bootstrap result to a current writable durable authority/bootstrap/dispatch anchor. This report is not supplied or performed by the fixture. If no authorized writable anchor exists, source explicitly permits only BOOTSTRAP_VALID_SESSION_LOCAL and NOT_DURABLY_ESTABLISHED.
